statusReasoning: As of 2026-09-02 a trademark attorney has reviewed the one remaining item — the COREXTEND (MIPS Tech) adjacency in class 9 — and concluded there is no conflict: CoreTend and COREXTEND are two entirely separate products with two entirely separate meanings, different field of use, non-overlapping trade channels and relevant public. This satisfies the human attorney review that the 2026-07-27 status made a prerequisite for the 1.0 release, so the name is cleared for continued use including v1.0.0. Prior automated evidence still stands: TMview (aggregating ~80 offices incl. EUIPO, INPI, USPTO, WIPO, UKIPO) returned ZERO rows for 'contains: coretend' across 141,856,516 marks on 2026-07-27, and GitHub/npm/PyPI/Homebrew/Mac App Store were all re-verified negative with no same-category conflict. This is NOT a claim of registration, NOT a ® right, and no trademark application has been filed. See the `attorneyReview` block; the written opinion is held by the maintainer.

GitHub code search, private repositories, and pending/unpublished trademark applications are structurally invisible to this method.

No non-Latin-script, transliteration, or Cyrillic/CJK variant screening was performed.

recommendedHumanStep: Commission a paid professional trademark search from a trademark attorney or professional search provider, covering Nice classes 9 and 42 across EUIPO, INPI (FR), UKIPO, USPTO and WIPO/Madrid, including similarity and phonetic searching — that is the step that can produce a real clearance opinion, which this document cannot. In parallel: (a) identify the registrant behind coretend.com via registrar WHOIS or a watch service, without contacting them before taking advice; (b) set a watch on CoreTend/Coretend in classes 9 and 42 and on the .com/.app/.io domain set; (c) optionally re-run this automated screening from an environment with browser automation, which could query the JavaScript register front-ends and convert several limitations into evidence.

statusHistory.reason: Zero of six target official registers was reachable with the tools available that day; public/software sources were clean.

Official-register condition satisfied via TMview (aggregates ~80 offices incl. EUIPO, INPI, USPTO, WIPO, UKIPO): 0 marks contain the string 'coretend' across 141,856,516 records. Software/package channels re-verified clean. Nearest neighbour COREXTEND recorded as a watch item, not a high conflict.

The maintainer reports that a trademark attorney reviewed the COREXTEND adjacency and concluded CoreTend and COREXTEND are non-conflicting — distinct products (a consumer macOS maintenance application vs. an embedded-CPU instruction-set-extension IP facility) with distinct meanings ('tend / care for' vs 'extend'), non-overlapping trade channels and relevant public. The name is cleared for continued use including the v1.0.0 stable release. This is the human attorney review the 2026-07-27 status made a prerequisite for 1.0; it does not constitute a claim of registration or ® rights and no application has been filed.

officialRegisterEvidence.caveat: TMview states in its own footer that its results do not constitute official registers and have no legal effect. Only literal 'contains' queries were run — no phonetic, fuzzy, transliteration or figurative-similarity search.

nearestNeighbour.assessment: WATCH — recorded, not dismissed; not a high conflict for this launch
whyNotHighConflict: Different field of use: MIPS CoreExtend is a user-defined instruction-set extension facility for embedded CPU cores (semiconductor IP licensed to chip designers); CoreTend is a consumer macOS maintenance application. Trade channels and relevant public do not overlap.
Different construction and pronunciation: 'core-extend' (3 syllables, built on 'extend') vs 'core-tend' (2 syllables, built on 'tend', to care for). Conceptually opposite in kind.
No product-name collision: no shipped product, package, cask, App Store listing or repository is named CoreTend.

charging money for CoreTend or any commercial exploitation
